name: bothouse 组织智能体与记忆
description: 让九问的智能体带上 bothouse 角色人设、飞书需求卡/话题进度分离，以及全队共享记忆论坛。

display_name.zh: bothouse 组织智能体与记忆

display_description.en: Adds bothouse role persona, Feishu need cards, topic-isolated execution with one progress card, and a shared team memory forum.
display_description.zh: 为九问 AI 同事提供人设、飞书需求卡、话题干活与进度卡分离，以及全队共享记忆论坛。

default_init_input.zh: 对当前需求做一次需求分析并生成飞书需求卡
default_init_input.en: Run a requirement analysis and send a Feishu need card

quick_inputs.zh: 对当前需求做一次需求分析并生成飞书需求卡
quick_inputs.en: Run a requirement analysis and send a Feishu need card

quick_inputs.zh: 在全队记忆论坛里查一下以前定过的规矩
quick_inputs.en: Search the shared team memory forum for past rules

quick_inputs.zh: 把这件活开飞书话题并挂出进度卡
quick_inputs.en: Open a Feishu topic and post the progress card

display_description.en: Collects group quotes, shared memory rules, and acceptance criteria into a Feishu interactive need card.
display_description.zh: 汇总群聊原话、记忆论坛历史规则和验收标准，发出带确认按钮的飞书需求卡。

display_description.en: Keeps agent work logs inside a Feishu topic, updates one progress card in-place, and checks stuck tasks.
display_description.zh: 把干活来回关进飞书话题，主群只原地刷新一张进度卡，并支持卡住提醒与交回检查。

display_description.en: Searches shared team memory threads, cites rules, records corrections, and promotes repeat mistakes to checks.
display_description.zh: 检索全队共享记忆论坛，记录纠正并夜间归帖投票，同类错第二次自动升成检查。

display_description.en: Injects persona and shared team memory forum hits before each model call and checks stuck tasks.
display_description.zh: 每次调用模型前注入人设与全队共享记忆论坛命中规则，并巡检卡住任务。
